_doc: Per-body inputs of the small-body sources table (src/sources_small.hpp). lon_left is the east longitude of the file's left edge read LITERALLY from its GeoTIFF (clon + x0 / metres per degree); the IAU gazetteer crater-contrast scan (tools/small/orientation-scan.py) confirmed it and found no mirrored product. max_level: the deepest level whose pixel is at least 0.69 of the source pixel.

bodies.orientation: Only 15 named features and 7 craters: the gazetteer scan cannot separate the mirror. Read literally like Pluto (same producer, same frame); Pirx (55.2N 256.3E, 90 km) is a centred crater at the literal position and absent at the mirrored one, Argo Chasma likewise.
